modification_description: The phased transition plan must include explicit household-protecting constraints as first-class requirements: a defined minimum financial runway/emergency fund threshold before quitting, an agreed budget cap on painting-related spending, evidence-based measurable milestones for the transition checkpoint (portfolio readiness, practice hours, income targets), a maximum decision timeline (e.g., 12 months), and a contingency clause requiring plan adjustment if milestones are not met—preventing risk from being gradually transferred to the household partner without consent.
